map.仅启用 TLS 1.2 和 TLS 1.3。TLS 1.3 强制前向保密（PFS: Enable only TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3. TLS 1.3 mandates forward secrecy (PFS) and removes RSA key exchange, static DH, CBC mode, RC4, MD5, SHA-1, and similar.
map.AES-256-GCM 加密 + SHA-384 消息认证，TLS 1.3 强制: AES-256-GCM encryption + SHA-384 MAC; one of the mandatory TLS 1.3 suites, extremely secure
map.ChaCha20-Poly1305，移动设备性能优秀，无硬件加速时优于 AES-: ChaCha20-Poly1305; excellent on mobile, outperforms AES-GCM without hardware acceleration
map.AES-128-GCM，性能与安全性平衡之选: AES-128-GCM; a balanced choice of performance and security
map.ECDHE 密钥交换（PFS）+ RSA 认证 + AES-256-GCM，TL: ECDHE key exchange (PFS) + RSA auth + AES-256-GCM; recommended TLS 1.2 configuration

map.TLS 采用混合加密：握手阶段用非对称加密交换对称密钥，数据传输阶段用对称加密。: TLS uses hybrid encryption: asymmetric encryption exchanges the symmetric key during the handshake, and symmetric encryption is used for data transfer.

map.查阅握手/证书/协议版本。: Look up handshake, certificates, and protocol versions.
map.证书到期前核对信息：确认签发者、有效期、SAN 覆盖的域名与协议版本，避免上线后: Verify information before certificate expiry: confirm issuer, validity period, SAN-covered domains, and protocol version to avoid discovering a mismatch only after going live.
map.TLS1.3 握手 1-RTT、废弃 TLS1.0/1.1。: TLS 1.3 handshake is 1-RTT; TLS 1.0/1.1 are obsolete.
map.服务器证+中间 CA+根 CA 逐级信任。: Server cert + intermediate CA + root CA form a hierarchical trust.
map.为什么浏览器说证书无效？: Why does the browser say the certificate is invalid?
map.常见原因有五：证书已过期、域名与 SAN 不匹配、中间证书缺失导致链不完整、系统: Five common causes: the certificate has expired, the domain does not match the SAN, a missing intermediate certificate breaks the chain, the system clock is wrong, or the certificate has been revoked (requires OCSP/CRL check). Self-signed certificates are also not publicly trusted. Check in this order and most issues can be pinpointed.
